branchName.instructions: Use `<type>/<short-kebab-slug>` with a Conventional Commits type (feat, fix, perf, refactor, docs, test, build, ci, chore); with a GitHub issue `<type>/<issue>-<slug>`, e.g. `feat/12-session-list`.

commitMessage.instructions: Conventional Commits in English: `<type>[(scope)][!]: <description>`, lowercase imperative description, no trailing period, e.g. `feat: list agent sessions in the sidebar`.

pullRequest.instructions: The title becomes the squash commit on main, so it follows the commit message style: Conventional Commits, English. The body is in English: what changed and why; keep `Closes #<issue>` when the branch has an issue.
